# MM-P3-L4-RR01 Maintenance manual - Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-RR01

Scope
This manual provides maintenance instructions and acceptance criteria for the Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) installed on line P3-L4. It covers preventive lubrication, clamp bolt torque verification, bearings inspection, and record keeping required to support safe, repeatable operation in the heat treat cell. This document aligns with shop best practices and references related procedural documents (SB-1028, SOP-P3-L4-02, SOP-P3-L4-03).

Background and rationale
Radial ring rolling mills in heat treat service are subject to cyclic loading, elevated ambient conditions near furnaces, and contamination from scale and quench media. Critical interfaces include the mandrel clamp and main roll bearings. The mandrel clamp bolt preload directly affects ring control and concentricity during rolling; loss of preload can produce out-of-tolerance parts and pose safety risks. Main roll bearings require a consistent lubrication cadence to preserve film thickness and prevent premature fatigue. Prescribed torque and lubrication intervals are set to maintain preload and bearing life while accommodating the mill's operating environment.

Tools
- Calibrated torque wrench capable of applying the required clamp bolt torque as specified below, with current calibration certificate referenced in maintenance records.
- Clean, lint-free rags and approved bearing-grade grease compatible with the bearing manufacturer recommendations and SOP-P3-L4-02.
- Low-pressure grease gun compatible with the mill grease fittings.
- Inspection lamp and borescope for visual assessment of bearing seals and mandrel surfaces.
- Personal protective equipment as required by SOP-P3-L4-03 and SB-1028, including heat-resistant gloves and eye protection.
- Maintenance log forms and electronic entry device for records retention.

Critical values
- The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 605 N·m.
- The main roll bearing lubrication interval for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 160 hours.

Procedure
Preparation
- Verify lockout/tagout and energy isolation in accordance with SOP-P3-L4-03 before any disassembly or torque application. Ensure the mill is at a safe cool-down state per SB-1028 prior to hand contact with components.
- Review the bearing and clamp maintenance history in the equipment records to confirm the last torque verification and lubrication entry. Retrieve the torque wrench calibration certificate.

Mandrel clamp bolt torque verification
- Clean the clamp bolt head and surrounding area to remove grease and debris so the torque wrench can seat properly.
- Set the calibrated torque wrench to the specified value: the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 605 N·m. Use the wrench slowly and smoothly to achieve the value; apply final torque in a controlled motion to avoid impact loading.
- If the bolt does not reach the specified torque due to rotation, remove, inspect threads and seating surfaces for wear or contamination, clean or replace as required, and reapply torque to the specified value.
- Document the applied torque, torque wrench serial number, and operator initials in the maintenance log. Note any deviations and corrective actions taken.

Main roll bearing lubrication
- Confirm the main roll bearing lubrication interval for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is up to date in the maintenance schedule. If the interval has elapsed, proceed with lubrication.
- Clean grease fitting area and attach grease gun. Pump grease until purge from the bearing seal indicates adequate fill, taking care not to over-grease bearing housings. Use grease types and quantities recommended by the bearing supplier as recorded in equipment procurement and SB-1028.
- Inspect bearing seals, housings, and adjacent components for signs of overheating, contamination, or grease degradation. If abnormal conditions are observed, tag out the equipment and escalate per SOP-P3-L4-02.
- Record lubricant type, lot code, grease gun identifier, and date/time of lubrication in the maintenance log.

Bearing and component inspection
- Using the inspection lamp and borescope, examine bearing seals, mandrel surface, and roll journals for scoring, spalling, corrosion, or contamination. Note presence of embedded particles or discoloration indicative of overheating or contamination.
- If damage is detected that could compromise operation, document findings with photos, remove the component for shop-level inspection, and reference corrective actions in SB-1028.

Examples and rationale
- Example record entry: torque confirmation entry should list the applied torque value (605 N·m), torque wrench ID, calibration date, and operator initials. This provides traceability for audits and failure analysis.
- Rationale for lubrication cadence: the main roll bearing lubrication interval for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 160 hours to maintain consistent grease film under cyclic loading and elevated ambient conditions near heat treat equipment. Deviating from this interval increases risk of fatigue failure.

Records to keep
- Torque verification form including applied torque (605 N·m), torque tool identifier, calibration certificate reference, operator, date/time, and any corrective actions.
- Lubrication log noting lubricant type, lot code, grease gun ID, interval completion (main roll bearing lubrication interval for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 160 hours), operator, and observations.
- Inspection reports and photos for bearing and clamp surfaces.
- Reference to related procedural documents: SB-1028, SOP-P3-L4-02, SOP-P3-L4-03.

Acceptance criteria
- Mandrel clamp bolt torque is confirmed at the specified value: the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 605 N·m. Torque verification form completed and signed.
- Main roll bearings have received lubrication within the scheduled cadence: the main roll bearing lubrication interval for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P3-L4-RR01) is 160 hours, and the lubrication log entry is present.
- No visual indications of bearing distress, mandrel damage, or contamination above limits described in SB-1028. Any deviations must be escalated per SOP-P3-L4-02 and corrective actions documented.
- Maintenance actions and records must be retained per plant records policy and be available for review alongside SB-1028, SOP-P3-L4-02, and SOP-P3-L4-03.
